svg.title: B-Tree Index
svg.desc: B-Tree Index. How a B-tree index finds a row in three or four page reads, serves ranges in order, and what every insert costs to keep it sorted. Step 1, No index: read everything: No index on customer_id: a parallel Seq Scan reads all 5,058 pages to return 179 of 500,000 rows. Step 2, Walk down the B-tree: CREATE INDEX: 3 page reads find 42's 179 TIDs in leaf 14; a bitmap fetches their 175 heap pages. Step 3, When the planner uses it: Ranges walk the linked leaves; when most rows match, the planner skips the index for a Seq Scan. Step 4, What every write pays: Each INSERT adds an entry to every index; a full leaf splits, and every index adds WAL.

g.text: No index on customer_id: a parallel Seq Scan reads all 5,058 pages to return 179 of 500,000 rows.
CREATE INDEX: 3 page reads find 42's 179 TIDs in leaf 14; a bitmap fetches their 175 heap pages.
Ranges walk the linked leaves; when most rows match, the planner skips the index for a Seq Scan.
Each INSERT adds an entry to every index; a full leaf splits, and every index adds WAL.
SELECT id, status, created_at, total_thb FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 42
SELECT id, status, created_at, total_thb FROM orders WHERE customer_id BETWEEN 42 AND 47
SELECT id, status, created_at, total_thb FROM orders WHERE customer_id = 1
SELECT id, status, created_at, total_thb FROM orders WHERE status = 'delivered'
so the plan reads every page and checks every row
page 46 holds 99 rows; customer 42 has one of them
499,821 rows filtered out · 179 kept, after reading all 5,058 pages
179 TIDs in 2 posting lists, sorted by heap page
Index the foreign keys you query by
PostgreSQL doesn't create them: orders.customer_id had no index
The planner skips the index here
orders_status_idx exists, but for 97% of the rows one pass is cheaper
Gather → Parallel Seq Scan reads every page
Bitmap Heap Scan: 175 pages, in page order
Seq Scan: 97% of the rows match
INSERT: the row goes on the last page
then one new entry in each of the 3 indexes
Gather → Parallel Seq Scan · 499,821 rows filtered out
Bitmap Index Scan → Bitmap Heap Scan
Bitmap Heap Scan · leaf 14 → right link → leaf 15
Seq Scan · orders_status_idx exists, not used
